emails.subject: Q1 market data follow-up
emails.body:
Hi Daniel,

Thanks again for walking us through the Q1 review last week — the team's already chewing on a couple of the regional momentum points.

Could you send over the Q1 market data you walked us through so we can fold it into our Q2 planning doc? Whatever format is easiest is fine — a CSV or a quick paste in the body both work.

Appreciated!
— Priya
VP Marketing, Acme Corp
(312) 555-0184
